chapters.text: What is a typical day for you? So usually I wake up at 7 and then I have my breakfast and go to school, which starts at half past 8, and then I have some lessons and I have my lunch and go back home. A typical day for me is to get up around 7 o'clock, have breakfast, get my children ready for school, and then take the kids to school, then I'll get the bus at about 9 o'clock, get into work at about 10 o'clock, and I always start the day with a coffee at my desk,

chapters.title: and then check emails, do my job, and I'll have lunch around...
chapters.text: and then check emails, do my job, and I'll have lunch around 12 o'clock until about half past 12, finish work at 6 o'clock, get the bus home, and then have dinner with my family. We always have dinner together, and then put the children to bed, and then I can relax. I usually wake up at about 6.30 in the morning, I go jogging every morning, and then I arrive at work at about 9 o'clock, finish work at about 5 o'clock,

chapters.title: and then have dinner at about 7 o'clock, and then I usually...
chapters.text: and then have dinner at about 7 o'clock, and then I usually go to bed at about 9. I normally get up at 7.30, then I have a shower, then I take the bus to work. I usually start work at about 9.30, and I finish at 5.30. After work, I walk home, then when I'm at home, I cook dinner, and in the evening, I usually watch a film or read a book.

chapters.title: I get up at 7 a.m. in the morning and usually have...
chapters.text: I get up at 7 a.m. in the morning and usually have eggs for breakfast. Sometimes I go swimming before work, but if I don't, I get ready for work and go to work at 9 a.m., and then I get off at 5 p.m.
